description: Open cases (spec/SPEC.md §4.4): the recipient opens with its own sealing key (seal_seed, test data). P4: (a) the content under the AAD of a different to or from; (b) a wrap sealed with the other recipient as AAD; (c) enc replaced by each small-order X25519 point; (d) a wrap ct byte changed; (e) the content tag changed. F2: the sealed part under the attacker as from. F8: wraps swapped. D6: a sealed content with two type members.
test_data: Every seed, private key, content key and nonce in this file is test data: each comes from xorshiftRng(20261025) (packages/core/test/support/rng.ts). They are public; never let them protect anything real.
